name: DuctForge
tagline: The job runs the shop, not the other way around.
positioning: DuctForge is the field service platform built for HVAC owner-operators who dispatch, invoice, and chase parts before 7am.

hero.h1: Every service call, from ring to paid, in one place.
hero.sub: DuctForge handles dispatch, quotes, part lookups, and invoicing so you can stop running the shop from your truck's center console. Built for HVAC crews under 25 techs.

features.title: Dispatch that survives Monday
features.description: Drag jobs across your board, see who's closest, and text the customer an arrival window automatically. No more calling three techs to find who's free.

features.title: Quotes before you leave the driveway
features.description: Build a repair or replacement quote on the tablet, pull equipment models from the unit's serial, and get a signature on-site. It syncs to the invoice instantly.

features.title: Parts you actually have
features.description: Track van stock and shop shelves in real time. DuctForge flags when a job needs a capacitor you're out of and lists the nearest supplier with it.

features.title: Invoices that don't wait
features.description: Send the invoice the moment the job closes, accept card or ACH on-site, and watch aging drop. Automatic reminders chase the slow payers for you.

features.title: Maintenance agreements on autopilot
features.description: Schedule spring and fall tune-ups for every service member, auto-generate the visits, and never let a renewal quietly lapse again.

features.title: Numbers your accountant asks for
features.description: See revenue per tech, close rate on replacements, and callback percentage without exporting to a spreadsheet at midnight.

testimonials.quote: I used to reconcile paper tickets on Sundays. Now the invoice goes out before the tech backs out of the driveway. We cut our average days-to-paid from 41 to 9.
testimonials.name: Marcus Trejo

testimonials.quote: The van inventory tracking alone paid for DuctForge. We stopped losing an hour a day driving back to the shop for a part we thought we had.
testimonials.name: Danielle Osei

testimonials.quote: My techs actually fill out the job notes now because it takes fifteen seconds on the tablet. Our callback rate is down because nothing gets lost.
testimonials.name: Ray Bfeld

pricing.blurb: For the owner running one or two trucks.
For growing shops with a dispatcher and multiple techs.

homepage.footerBlurb: DuctForge is field service software for independent HVAC shops. Dispatch, quote, stock, and get paid — all before the next call comes in.
